learningObjectives: Understand array shape, dimensions, indexing, and slicing
Apply vectorized operations to numerical data

activities.title: Array Anatomy
activities.instruction: Click each part of the array to explore its structure.

content.concept: NumPy arrays store numerical data in structured dimensions and support efficient mathematical operations.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Shape Explorer
activities.instruction: Change the dimensions and observe the array shape.

content.concept: An array's shape describes the size of each dimension and determines how data is organized.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Index and Slice
activities.instruction: Select indexes to reveal the corresponding array values.

content.concept: NumPy supports zero-based indexing and flexible slicing for accessing subsets of arrays.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Vectorized Operations
activities.instruction: Build an operation using arrays and mathematical operators.

content.concept: Vectorization applies operations across arrays efficiently without manually iterating through every element.
